Name: Configure SQL Server Private Endpoint
Description: The Azure SQL Server does not have an approved private endpoint connection. Configure and approve a private endpoint, including private DNS and network connectivity.
ImpactWarning: Private endpoint creation requires selecting a suitable virtual network, subnet, DNS configuration and connection approval. These values are environment-specific, so a generic CLI command is not generated.

Name: Enforce Storage Account SAS Expiration Policy
Description: The Storage Account does not enforce a valid SAS expiration policy. Configure an expiration period and set the expiration action to Block.
ImpactWarning: SAS tokens that exceed the configured expiration period may be blocked. Review applications, integrations and existing SAS token usage before applying.
